==Description==
This template will change the displayed title (next to the edit button) on pages in any namespace. 

Articles in the main namespace should use the wiki magic word <nowiki>{{DISPLAYTITLE:Title here}}</nowiki> (note the ":" instead of the template's "|"). The magic word does not work in any namespace other than the main. 

This template should only be used to change formatting (i.e. italics). Possible future uses include changes to the [[:Category:Chapter summaries|chapter subpages]] to show the chapter name. Please add any suggestions to this template's talk page.

==Usage==
The following code placed on a category page will italicize the category title:
<pre>{{DISPLAYTITLE|''Category name''}}</pre>

Partial formatting is possible. In the example, the title of the page would show ''Atha'an Miere'' in italics, but show (people) as normal:
<pre>{{DISPLAYTITLE|''Atha'an Miere'' (people)}}</pre>

The following code placed on any page will change the title completely. In the example, Rand's page title will show in all caps:
<pre>{{DISPLAYTITLE|RAND AL'THOR}}</pre>

The following code will remove the namespace name from the title:
<pre>{{DISPLAYTITLE|{{PAGENAME}}}}</pre>

<noinclude>[[Category:Template documentation|{{PAGENAME}}]]</noinclude>
